name: layoffs-tracker
description: Open US layoffs tracker built on WARN Act filings. 47,000+ notices from 43 state labor departments, all 50 states, updated daily.

scripts.build: bun scripts/build-db.js && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.kit:sync: for f in kit.css index.jsx README.md MIGRATION.md; do curl -fsS https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kadoa-org/congress-trading-monitor/main/src/kit/$f -o src/kit/$f; done
